blocks.raw: <WikiMistakeList mistakes={["Confusing W-section flange width with height: W sections are identified as W(depth)×(unit weight); a W460×89 is 460 mm deep, not wide.","Applying the compression KL/r limit (200) to tension members: tension allows KL/r ≤ 300 (preferred); no AISC limit for tension > 300, but design judgment advised.","Treating gusset plates as load-carrying members: gusset plates are _transition_ geometry; they concentrate stress and require local analysis.","Ignoring section orientation: a C-channel is stronger with web vertical (I-like bending) than horizontal; always check intended use.","Assuming all built-up sections are more efficient: built-up sections are heavier and require field welding; use only when rolled shapes cannot fit."]} />
